heading: Privacy notice (Welsh version)
intro1: The 'Victim pathfinder: {{applicationName}}' service is provided by the Ministry of Justice (MOJ). The Ministry of Justice is committed to the protection and security of your personal information.
intro2: It is important that you read this privacy notice so that you are aware of how and why we are using such information.
whatDataWeCollect.intro: We collect and use the following information:
whatDataWeCollect.items: questions, queries or feedback you enter and save, including your email address if you decide to leave feedback or volunteer to participate in post-beta usage research sessions
whatDataWeCollect.item.ipPre: your Internet Protocol (IP) address, and details of which
whatDataWeCollect.item.cookiesPre: information on how you use the site,
heading.whatWeDoWithYourData: What we do with your data
whatWeDoWithYourData.para1: No information that you provide will be shared outside the Ministry of Justice, other than with Ministry of Justice IT providers that provide services supporting the running of this service.
whatWeDoWithYourData.willNotItems: sell or rent data to third parties
share data with third parties for marketing purposes
whatWeDoWithYourData.para3: Most of the personal information we use to:
whatWeDoWithYourData.useItems: allowing your access to the service for private beta
contact you if you sign up to take part in user research
understand the performance of the service
whatWeDoWithYourData.para4Pre: Where you provide your consent, we use
whatWeDoWithYourData.para4Post: cookies to collect information about how you use {{applicationName}}. This includes your Internet Protocol (IP) addresses.
heading.contactUs: Contact us or make a complaint
contactUs.items: have a question about anything in this privacy notice
think that your personal data has been misused or mishandled
heading.peopleInPrison: People in prison or on probation
allOthers.para: If you have any concerns about our use of your personal data, you can contact the Ministry of Justice data protection officer.

ico.para: When we ask you for information, we will comply with the law. If you consider that your information has been handled incorrectly, you can contact the Information Commissioner's Office for independent advice about data protection.
changesToPolicy.para: We may change this privacy notice. In that case, the 'last updated' date at the bottom of this page will also change. Any changes to this privacy notice will apply to you and your data immediately.
